d:
Here's House of LSD. A webcomic created by J3T (real name being Jodi Tong) that started in 2002 and stop in around January of 2007. The comic basically focus around a porn studio of the same name that is owned by three sister cats: Luna, Skye, and Devi (thus, the "LSD" part of the name) while a wide range of comedy happen in and out of studio. The comic is highly sexual, pornographic, and centers around sexual comedy (most often sexual incompetence).

The was co-written by StickDevil (or DuckDraw they now go by) uncredited but help out who many of the characters' personality quirks and storylines as well as some guest strips.

This is an older comic of the reboot with the same name.

Here's a link to the reboot comic:
https://e-hentai.org/g/4138938/8967d9cb39
